extracted.intended_audience: Organizations and investigators preparing full proposals for the DoD MURI FY25 opportunity (ONR/ARO/AFOSR) via Grants.gov/FedConnect
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting a full proposal in response to the FY25 MURI announcement (ONR/ARO/AFOSR), including required forms, technical proposal content, budget justification, data management plan, and regulatory compliance documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: SAM registration and UEI
rubrics_metrics.description: All organizations applying online through FedConnect or Grants.gov must register with the System for Award Management (SAM) and provide a valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SAM registration must be completed prior to submission and renewed annually. Failure to register with SAM will prevent applying. A Federal awarding agency may not make a Federal award until the Applicant has complied with all applicable UEI and SAM requirements. SAM may be accessed at https://www.sam.gov/SAM.

rubrics_metrics.name: FedConnect account and SAM MPIN
rubrics_metrics.description: If applying via FedConnect, create a FedConnect account and, if you are the first person in your organization to register in FedConnect, provide your SAM Marketing Partner ID (SAM MPIN).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The SAM MPIN is set up as part of SAM.gov registration. Note: DO NOT use the FedConnect message center to submit white paper responses or questions related to this announcement; email the point of contact in Section G instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants.gov registration and account roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must register with Grants.gov and create an account/profile; organizations must have an active SAM registration and an EBiz POC must authorize Grants.gov roles (e.g., AOR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creating a Grants.gov account can be quick but SAM registration may take 7–10 days—start early. Add an organizational profile by entering the organization's UEI. The EBiz POC must authorize individuals who can make legally binding commitments as the Authorized Organization Representative (AOR). The AOR name inserted on submission serves as the electronic signature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission channels: Grants.gov vs FedConnect
rubrics_metrics.description: Full proposals must be submitted online through Grants.gov; white papers must NOT be submitted through Grants.gov and must be submitted through FedConnect (for ONR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the agency-specific instructions for Grants.gov vs FedConnect. White Papers submitted to ONR must be submitted through FedConnect, not Grants.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory file formats and automated acceptance check
rubrics_metrics.description: Files attached to forms must be Adobe Portable Document Format (.PDF); cannot contain macros; and cannot be password protected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If any attachment is not a PDF, contains macros, or is password protected, it will not pass the automated acceptance check and will need to be resubmitted prior to the submission deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic file name length limit
rubrics_metrics.description: The electronic file name for all documents submitted under this FOA must not exceed 68 characters in length, including the file name extension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical proposal formatting and page limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical Proposal must use 8.5 x 11 inch paper, 1 inch margins, single-spaced, Times New Roman 12-point font, and is limited to 25 pages for the Technical Proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover Page and Table of Contents are not included in the page count. The Data Management Plan is not included in the page count. The Technical Proposal must be attached as a single PDF file saved as 'Technical Proposal' when uploading to Field 8 of the R&R Other Project Information form.

rubrics_metrics.name: SF-424 special field instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete SF-424 (R&R) cover page and follow special instructions for specific fields to ensure correct auto-population and routing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Field-specific guidance includes: Field 3 - Date Received by State: Leave Blank; Field 4a - Federal Identifier: enter 'N00014' for ONR, 'W36QYT' for ARO, 'FA9550' for AFOSR; Field 4b - Agency Routing Number: enter Research Topic Chief's Code/name as specified per agency (add leading zero if only two digits); Field 4c - Previous Grants.gov Tracking ID: provide if this is Changed/Corrected Application; Field 5 - provide email for EDA notification; Field 7 - Type of Applicant: indicate Minority-Serving Institution as 'Other' and note 'MI' if applicable; Field 9 - list appropriate reviewing agency; Field 11 - Descriptive Title: include 'MURI:' and the ONR White Paper Tracking Number; Field 14 - Project Director/PI email for EDA profile; Field 16 - choose 'No' for review by EO 12372; Field 17 - Certification: checking 'I Agree' certifies compliance and truthfulness; AFOSR: if 'I Agree' is checked and SF-LLL is not uploaded, you certify no lobbying to disclose; Field 19 - Authorized Representative (AOR): ensure signature delegation authority if name mismatch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project summary/abstract requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Project summary/abstract must identify the research problem and objectives, technical approaches, anticipated outcome, and impact on DoD capabilities; use only characters on a standard QWERTY keyboard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Spell out Greek letters and non-English symbols. Graphics are not allowed. One page or 4,000-character limit, whichever is less. Do not include proprietary or confidential information. The abstract must be marked 'Approved for Public Release'. Abstracts of funded projects will be posted on DTIC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Each proposal must address human subject involvement by completing Fields 1 and 1a of the R&R Other Project Information form and, if applicable, submit required documentation prior to award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For proposals containing or potentially containing human subjects research as defined in DoDI 3216.02, required documentation under 'Use of Human Subjects in Research' (Section F) must be provided prior to award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate animal use documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Each proposal must address vertebrate animal use by completing Fields 2 and 2a of the R&R Other Project Information form and submit required animal use documents if animals will be utilized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If animals are proposed, submit the documents described under 'Use of Animals' (Section F).

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental compliance and NEPA
rubrics_metrics.description: Address Fields 4a–4d on environmental compliance and briefly indicate whether the research will result in environmental impacts outside the laboratory and how compliance will be ensured.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal awardees must comply with environmental planning and regulatory requirements, including NEPA where applicable. Most laboratory-based basic/applied research is often covered by a NEPA categorical exclusion, but questions should be referred to the technical point of contact. If research constitutes a 'major Federal action' agencies may need to prepare environmental planning documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical proposal required structure and content
rubrics_metrics.description: The technical proposal must include a Cover Page (not included in page count), Table of Contents (not included), and substantive sections including Technical Approach, Management Approach, Principal Investigator Qualifications, and other specified sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover Page must include FOA number (agency-specific), title, technical contact, administrative contact, proposed period of performance, and identity of prime Applicant and subawardees. Table of Contents should list sections with page numbers. Technical Approach (included in page count) must describe objectives, scientific/technical concepts, complete research plan, data analysis, innovation, relation to state-of-the-art and other programs, potential breakthroughs, appropriate citations, and describe expected results/new knowledge. Technical Approach should include 'Future DoD Relevance' and 'Project Schedule and Milestones'. Management Approach (included in page count) must describe PI communication with co-investigators, data-sharing within team, conflict resolution, responsibilities, student training and student FTEs. Principal Investigator Qualifications (included in page count) should discuss qualifications of PI and other key personnel. Bibliography/References, Facilities & Other Resources, and Equipment must be uploaded as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Management Plan (DMP) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: A Data Management Plan (not included in page count) of no more than 2 pages must describe what data, software, and materials will be produced and how they will be managed and preserved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The DMP must address: types of data/software/materials; how data will be acquired; time/location of data acquisition if pertinent; how data will be processed; file formats and naming conventions; quality assurance/quality control measures; dataset origin when existing resources are used; standards for data and metadata content/format; appropriate timeframe for preservation; balance between preservation value and cost/administrative burden with justification for decisions; and a statement if data cannot be made public due to national security or CUI concerns (e.g., cannot be cleared in accordance with DoD Directive 5230.09). See DoD Instruction 3200.12.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliography & References and Facilities/Equipment attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload Bibliography & References Cited as a single PDF; provide Facilities & Other Resources and Equipment descriptions as specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Facilities & Other Resources should describe facilities available and any additional facilities proposed to be acquired at Applicant expense; indicate government-owned facilities already possessed that will be used. Equipment: describe any equipment available or proposed to be acquired, indicate government-owned equipment to be used, and justify the need for each equipment item. Vendor quotes required for capital equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Grants.gov R&R Budget form
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant must use Grants.gov forms including the Standard Form Research and Related (R&R) Budget Form from the application package template associated with the FOA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If options are proposed, include pricing for option periods; failure to include option costs will result in options not being included in award. Provide a detailed cost breakdown of all costs by cost category and calendar periods. Use an award start date of 01 May 2024 for budget purposes. Budgets should include an option for two additional years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget justification and required cost documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a separate PDF under Section K 'Budget Justification' providing appropriate justification/supporting documentation for each element of cost proposed; round costs to nearest dollar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemized budget should include Direct Labor with hours and unburdened rates and escalation rates for outyears; Administrative/Clerical labor justification if direct-charged; Fringe Benefits - attach fringe benefits rate agreement; Indirect Costs - show rates and calculations and provide negotiated rate agreement if available; de minimis 10% of MTDC allowed if no negotiated rate per 2 CFR 200.414(f).

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed allowable cost categories guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Budgets must include detailed breakout and justification for travel, subawards/subcontracts, consultants, materials & supplies, recipient-acquired equipment/facilities, and other direct costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Travel: provide purpose, origin/destination, approximate duration, number of travelers, estimated cost per trip, and justification; include travel for PI peer review attendance if applicable. Subawards/Subcontracts: describe work, include detailed cost proposal for each subrecipient using R&R budget form, include subrecipient name on budget justification; preferred to include subcontractor info with prime proposal but sealed envelope or emailed subcontract proposals to Program Officer at submission time are permitted. Consultants: breakdown hours, hourly rate, other costs, signed consulting agreement or documentation, and consultant statement of work if not identified elsewhere. Materials & Supplies: itemized list with quantities, unit prices, and basis for estimate (quotes, prior purchases). Recipient Acquired Equipment: justify purchases and provide itemized list with basis for estimate and vendor quotes; general-purpose equipment should not be requested unless mainly used for project. Other Direct Costs: itemize items such as graduate assistant tuition, lab fees, publication costs and basis for estimate. Fee/Profit: unallowable under assistance agreements but may be permitted on contracts issued by prime awardee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended funding profile and award durations
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommended funding profiles (dollar amounts and fiscal periods) differ by agency; example totals and year-by-year funding expectations are provided for ONR, ARO, and AFOSR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For ONR: recommended FY25–FY30 totals leading to a five-year total of $7,500,000 with a three-year base subtotal of $4,500,000 and two-year option subtotal of $3,000,000 (specific month ranges and amounts given). ARO and AFOSR profiles with month-by-month allocations are also provided; available budget is subject to change. AFOSR will not consider exceptions above $15,000,000 including additional funding and cost-sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: R&R Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: R&R Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) will collect degree type/year, upload biosketch (CV limited to 5 pages), and current & pending support (no page limit) for all senior/key personnel including PI and Co-PIs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Current & Pending Support must include for each project: title and objectives; percentage per year to be devoted to other projects; total amount of support the individual is receiving or would receive; name and address of supporting agencies/parties; period of performance. Applications missing required information may be deemed incomplete and returned without further review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and Related Personal Data (demographics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the Research and Related Personal Data form with name fields completed for PI and Co-PIs; provision of demographic information (gender, race, ethnicity, disability) is voluntary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demographic information may be accessible to reviewers but will not be considered in evaluation. Applicants who do not wish to provide some or all information should select 'Do not wish to provide' option. If completing for multiple individuals, add each person via 'Next Person'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 889 funding restrictions (covered telecommunications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recipients and subrecipients of awards issued on or after August 13, 2020 are prohibited from obligating or expending funds to procure or obtain, extend/renew contracts for, or enter into contracts to procure or obtain covered telecommunications equipment or services as defined in Section 889 of the NDAA for FY2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covered telecommunications equipment includes equipment produced by Huawei, ZTE, Hytera, Hangzhou Hikvision, Dahua, and any entity the Secretary of Defense (in consultation with DNI or FBI) reasonably believes is owned/controlled by or connected to a covered foreign country (People's Republic of China). Heads of executive agencies shall prioritize funding and technical support to assist affected entities to transition from covered communications equipment and services. See Public Law 115-232, section 889 for additional information.
